PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Prism Alpha: Low-Orbit Suppression
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: A deep-space gunship armed with a low-power Planet-Fracture Cannon, relativistic particle shots and a heavy-particle autocannon.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Bombards surface targets with orbital gunfire.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Vanguard Zeta: Orbital Bombardment
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: A deep-space warship with powerful ground-attack armament, capable of neutron autocannon fire and kinetic strikes.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Sweeps the battlefield with concentrated ground-attack fire.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Aurora: Strikecraft Legion
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: Launches a mixed strikecraft legion from the Aurora for a sixty-second attack run.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Swarms of strikecraft descend upon enemy positions in successive bombing runs.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Great Wyrm: Air-to-Air Sweep
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: Calls a Great Wyrm fighter formation to sweep hostile aircraft from the battlefield.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Fighter formations sweep through the skies, hunting hostile aircraft.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Aurora: Projected Energy Field
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: Projects a persistent Protoss energy field at a chosen location on any current map.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: A projected psionic field carries allied forces to a new foothold and anchors further warp-ins.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Aurora: Purification Beam
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: A steerable plasma jet fired by the secondary battery of the Aurora.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: A plasma jet sweeps across the ground, incinerating everything in its path.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Aurora: Supernova
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: Warps a contained supernova core to the designated location for two minutes.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Intense stellar radiation sears nearby enemies.

PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.label: Aurora: Recomposer
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.description: An orbital field breaks down living bodies and assembles them anew as Prometheus units.
PMP_Persona.ShipSupport.ShipSupportDef.effectDescription: Life outside your colony is remade within a golden field.
